releaseNotes:
Fit default mixing descent under the 125 Y ceiling

Raising 제조 위치 to 60 pushed the default recipe peak (seat + the old
80-step descent) to 140, over the 120 limit -- blocking recipe save and
forcing the runtime clamp to truncate the last descent.

- HW_Y_MAX_DOWN default + allowed-max 120 -> 125 (the real safe max).
  Both editors and the runtime clamp read this same bound.
- Default mixing program descent re-tuned to 10/15/15/10/10 (sum 60),
  waits 2000/2000/3000/3000/4000. With the 60 seat, peak = 120 (5-step
  margin under 125), so seeded recipes save cleanly and never clamp.

Seed-only (back-fill): applies to freshly provisioned tablets.
